local_validation.python_compile: lifecycle_source_proposal.py and sys12_outer_controller.py passed compile(source, filename, exec); no pycache writes
local_validation.remote_actions: none; no API, Task, Docker, Node, Network, file-root or product source changes executed

review_findings_addressed.node_name_order: Exact Admin GET for fresh NodeName runs after helper Task GET/readback and immediately before the prepare helper Run that starts container A; baseline four Node IDs must remain the same.
review_findings_addressed.sqlite_integrity: Read-only SQLite requires PRAGMA quick_check exactly ok. Opens a guarded O_NOFOLLOW FD, compares fstat/path lstat before and after query, returns db_dev/db_inode; persistence comparisons require the same DB identity across A, post-A pre-B, B, and post-reconnect.
review_findings_addressed.b_process_open_proof: B is directly started on the same owned bridge. Before SQLite query, bounded state.db file identity is used to verify exact immutable container ID and State.Pid, /proc state/startticks, UID65534, cgroup contains full container ID, executable SHA matches pinned Agent binary, container-root state.db inode matches, and an open /proc/PID/fd has the same dev+inode. Process/container identity is sampled again after SQLite reads. No argv/environment/credential is read.
review_findings_addressed.daemon_commit_recovery: cleanup-runtime recovers only the nonce-derived exact container/network names; it validates owner label, pinned full image ID, complete policy/mount and network properties before writing immutable IDs to owner/resource ledgers. It does not broadly list resources or recreate. Idempotent cleanup confirms exact absence if a prior delete completed before its ledger write.
review_findings_addressed.failed_phase_entrypoint: sys12_outer_controller.py has --recover-ledger; it pins both reviewed source hashes, cleans only IDs/exact random names from the private ledger, preserves Execution/Audit, and never reruns business Script Task/Run/Schedule. Root grant and explicit --execute are required.

business_scope.fixtures: one fresh Node, one Script with `printf` marker, one Script Task, one successful manual Execution, one disabled Schedule, two sequential containers, one bridge/shared DataDir; 6 helper Task/Run max
business_scope.script_cache: SQLite scripts row ID/revision/content_bytes/content SHA/stored SHA and execution ScriptID/ScriptRevision; same exact rows across B; no physical Script file is fabricated or expected.
business_scope.excluded: ArtifactCache, Applications, Transfers, Host integration, AppUnit/Host policy, original four Node mutation, primary:8080, source changes, Git operations.

controller: outer controller defaults to DRAFT_NO_ACTION. It requires --execute, --grant-id, reviewed lifecycle/controller SHA arguments, current private repair connection, and exact four protected Node IDs. Repair authority is constrained to 192.168.100.209:18080; credentials stay in memory/header only.
